summary: Specify and prove the dense ReLU layer and row selection, with reusable PTX machine definitions in a separate module

examined.reason: Reviewed the cumulative project contract: the real TorchLean layer is proved, PTX source is assembly-checked, and parameterized row-selection execution is now proved; memory, loop, complete-kernel and numerical correspondence remain unfinished.

Reviewed the cumulative initial child and exact source links against the unchanged architecture, state layout, supplied parameters, evaluation-mode forward program, and standalone pinned package. The new real-forward child depends on precisely this interface.

Reviewed the new pure real-valued interpreter, successful evaluation theorem, total output extraction, tensor identity, and universal coordinate theorem against all 93 source lines. The theorem follows from the actual sequential model under the upstream SpecM backend, with no independently authored graph or assumed result. Axiom audits exclude unfinished proofs.

Reviewed the unchanged assembly-checked PTX, its contract and exact source links. The new row-selection child formalizes the moves and low multiply-add with register updates and an explicit launch configuration; remaining instruction and full-kernel boundaries are recorded.

Reviewed the cumulative row-selection contract against the split 55-line Machine and 77-line RowSelection modules and unchanged 63-line checker. All declaration bodies and theorem statements are byte-identical to the previously checked single module. RowSelection imports the generic machine, keeps launch indexing and row proofs together, and remains the public entry point. The source link to moved definitions now resolves to Machine.lean. Existing runtime checks and theorem axiom audits pass after rebuilding.

results.method: LEAN_NUM_THREADS=1 lake build; lake env lean --run checks/RowSelection.lean; byte comparison of all moved declaration bodies and unchanged sources against prior checked snapshot; stratic validate; git diff --check
results.environment: Linux x86_64, Lean 4.34.0, pinned TorchLean/mathlib dependencies, one Lean worker, offline cached build
results.evidence: Build succeeded (3060 jobs), including Machine, RowSelection and library entry point. Existing Lean semantic edge cases and alternative launch specialization checked successfully. Public theorem audits retain only propext and Quot.sound; the concrete row-count theorem is axiom-free. Formal instructions, required block size and documented grid match the PTX source. Machine and RowSelection declaration bodies concatenate byte-for-byte to the prior single-file body; all other Lean code, checker, PTX and package pins are unchanged. Stratic validation has zero issues and whitespace check is clean. Before/after snapshots match. This is a file-organization change; existing full-kernel and numerical proof limitations remain.
